page.layout: One page of text: a heading at the top centre, then a list of numbered lines in the body; a printed ornament below the list; a word "FAMÆ" at lower right as a catchword-like heading. The digitiser's mark at lower right is excluded.
page.notes: The list numerals are printed in old-style figures (410–418); the line 417 is hyphenated across the line end as "Galli-/cana." The ornament between the list and the FAMÆ heading is a printed fleuron, not transcribed. Scan show-through and speckling omitted. The "FAMÆ" word appears as a heading set at the right, not a running head.
